correctness.rationale: The published construction provides the all-K polygon and foliation. For every N, matching the K-corner and N-shear endpoint to the quarter-turn gives r_N=(1+N delta)^{-1}. Det B=1 and det(P4,BP4)=-t delta give identical signed shoelace increments for all K+N quarter steps. The translation-to-center endpoint term is (1-2t r_N)/2, proving the exact polygon and sublevel areas. Consecutive rational rotation thresholds differ quadratically, yielding the sharp O(epsilon^2) interpolation error; tail integration proves infinite reciprocal mean. Boundary N=0 checked separately. The standalone checker executed numerical consistency checks K=3..6 and N=0,1,2,3,10,100; these are not used to prove the universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The source establishes integrability and arbitrarily slow boundary circulation but no quantification of the area of slow-moving invariant circles. The exact all-level sublevel law determines how a canonical invariant measure distributes winding frequencies and implies the nontrivial 1/R reciprocal-period tail and divergent mean even though almost every orbit winds with positive speed. This is a natural physical observable for the entire distinguished infinite parameter family, not a one-off numerical constant or gratuitous arithmetic slice; it may inform statistical sampling and comparison with intermittency near neutral boundaries.
